title: The geographic divide in general health, disability and unpaid care: Census 2021
meta_description: This interactive article explores health, disability, and unpaid care across England and Wales using data from Census 2021. It allows users to select a local authority area to see how it compares to the national picture.

breadcrumb.text: The geographic divide in general health, disability and unpaid care: Census 2021

lede: Despite improvements, parts of the north of England and areas of Wales had some of the highest proportions of people who reported being in bad or very bad health, were disabled and limited a lot in their day-to-day activities, or spent 20 hours or more per week providing unpaid care. How does your area compare?
